Persisted Surface Match runtime stages project into the same Run Record timing contract without rerunning matching, while missing or incompatible runtime evidence fails closed or remains explicitly unavailable.
JSON, HTML, CSV, Runner, and Shell Results expose the same timing values and continue to read legacy records without stage timing.
Focused verification, Release build, current Wide and Compact UI evidence, no-auto-execution checks, and refreshed R0 ValidateOnly checks pass.
